messages:
lucy (AE): Need quick alignment  Prospect wants to sign a 30-day POC orderform today. They supplied a PO, a vendor security questionnaire, and requested a KMS/HSM attestation. Buyer asks for milestone billing (POC fee + activation). Who needs to review before we send esign?

ben (sales-ops): Order form is in drive: https://drive.internal/po/strata-poc. Amount = $14,000 POC + $4,000 activation. Template match: OrderForm-Milestone-v5. I can attach PO + docs.

omar (finance): $14k under finance threshold; route = sales-manager -> finance reviewer. Need billing contact, vendor tax ID in envelope metadata (PO_NUMBER field). AP wants PO attached for matching. Net30 unless buyer requests otherwise.

rachel (legal): Any MSA/DPA redlines in the attachments? If so, we need to pause and review those prior to signature. Otherwise legal can be a post-sign reviewer and we can attach a KMS addendum. If buyer insists on our legal signature on the OF, escalate to me.

esign-bot: Template available: "OrderForm-Milestone-v5". API snippet to override sign order: ```{
  "templateId": "OrderForm-Milestone-v5",
  "signerOrder": ["ae_placeholder","sales_manager","finance_billing","customer_exec"]
}``` Link: https://docusign.internal/templates/OF-M-v5

sec-bot: Quick checklist: attach SOC2 link (https://security.redwood/soc2), KMS addendum template (https://legal.internal/templates/kms-attest-v3.docx), and subprocessors list. If they request HSM vendor certificate, infra will need 24-48h.

lucy (AE): They did not send redlines for MSA/DPA. Buyer wants the KMS attestation language included in the envelope: "Redwood will store customer-specific cryptographic keys in EU HSM-backed key stores upon request." Can legal sign that?

rachel (legal): We can include that as an addendum (non-warranty attestation) and attach it to the envelope. Legal won't sign the OF for an addendum alone; we will remain reviewer unless they change other contract terms. If they swap warranty words to "warrants", send to infra + legal for 48h review.

ben (sales-ops): Plan: single envelope with OF + KMS addendum + questionnaire + PO. Signer order proposed: AE -> Sales Manager -> Customer Exec -> Finance (billing attach). Legal set as reviewer. I'll populate PO_NUMBER and BILLING_CONTACT custom fields.

omar (finance): Fine. AP request: include invoice line items for each milestone so accounting can auto-match. If buyer wants activation invoice split after go-live, we will issue a second invoice.

lucy (AE): Buyer OKs single envelope. They want signatures today so POC can start tomorrow morning. Ben please send once PO_NUMBER and billing contact are set.

rachel (legal): Drafted and uploaded KMS addendum: https://legal.internal/drafts/kms-attest-strata-v1.docx. Minimal attestation language.

b\u0065n (sales-ops): (typo correction) Sending envelope now. Set signerOrder per template override and attached docs. PO_NUMBER custom field = 2025-STR-001.

esign-bot: Envelope created: https://docusign.internal/envelopes/EV-5102030405. Sign order = [ae_placeholder, sales_mgr, customer_exec, finance_billing]. Legal flagged as post-sign reviewer.

omar (finance): AP confirmed receipt of PO copy. Will process invoices after sign-off; Net30.

lucy (AE): Thanks team. I'll watch for signature events and confirm POC kickoff when fully executed. Closing after execution. :rocket:
